reason: The patch adds `webauthnLoginWithDiscoverableKey_reauthentication` twice, at PasskeysUsernameFormTest.java:261-321 and PasskeysOrganizationAuthenticationTest.java:270-321, identical except for the password-removal block at PasskeysUsernameFormTest.java:281-287 (about 50 shared lines). `webauthnLoginWithExternalKey_reauthentication` (PasskeysUsernamePasswordFormTest.java:215-274) copies `passwordLoginWithExternalKey` (173-207) nearly verbatim and shares about 30 of its 60 lines with the Discoverable variant, so "about 60" is somewhat overstated for that pair.
